page.layout: Running head top: page number 122 left, running title "Roma Irreconciliabilis" right. One text column in a ruled box, with a marginal note in the left margin ("Possid. in vita Aug."). Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. Catchword "liga-" at the bottom left below the rule; signature "SECT." at the bottom right.

main_text.p: ligaminis imperium, nos non adeo improbandam iudicamus. Nec alia putamus collegia nostra, quàm sacratiora quaedam ἀσκητήρια, in quibus iuxta Pelagij Papae praeceptum, sacris Dei ac Ecclesiae muneribus obeundis mature instrui, & aptari possimus. Talia fuere & veterum monasteria; ut vel ex vna aedicula, decem in Clerum emisisse Augustinum, author sit Possidonius.Possid. in vita Aug.

page.notes: The Greek word after "quaedam" is partly illegible and is transcribed as a best reading. The asterisk ornaments and the dagger-like mark near the foot are typographic ornaments. The lower text of the reverse page showing through is not transcribed.
